full_prompt_en: A square color photograph shows a man seated in the middle of a patterned sofa inside a crowded art studio. Pink walls fill the background from edge to edge, almost entirely covered by layered paintings, scribbles, broad brush marks, and pinned canvases. The marks range from pale aqua and yellow to coral, deep blue, black, and white; none of the small writing-like shapes is legible. A larger rectangular canvas hangs high at the right, while a smaller pale picture sits near the upper middle. Below them, the long sofa stretches nearly across the frame. Its floral upholstery is mottled with pink, cream, blue, and orange, and a mustard-yellow cushion rests at each end. The man faces forward at the sofa's center, wearing a dark cap, tan pinstriped suit, white shirt, and narrow dark tie. His knees spread apart and his hands meet loosely in his lap. Pale socks show above brown shoes, which extend onto the paint-spattered concrete floor. He looks directly toward the camera with a quiet expression, forming a small, still center within the busy room. To the right of the sofa, a side surface holds cans and other studio materials. More loose marks, scraps, and smears appear across the floor in the foreground. The photograph records the rough paint layers and worn fabric plainly, without smoothing their irregular surfaces. Soft indoor daylight spreads from the front and right, lighting the man, sofa, and wall evenly while leaving only mild shadows beneath the furniture. The overall composition balances a centered seated figure and symmetrical yellow cushions against an exuberant, disorderly field of color and handmade traces.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色照片呈现一名男子坐在拥挤艺术工作室里一张花纹沙发的中央。粉色墙壁从一边铺到另一边，几乎全被层层画作、涂写、宽阔笔迹和钉挂的画布覆盖。痕迹从浅青、黄到珊瑚红、深蓝、黑与白，细小近似文字的形状都无法辨认。右上方挂着一幅较大的长方形画布，上部中央附近另有一张较小的浅色图画。下方长沙发几乎横跨整个画面。花纹布面斑驳着粉、奶油色、蓝和橙色，两端各放一只芥黄色靠垫。男子正对前方坐在沙发中央，戴深色帽子，穿棕褐色细条纹西装、白衬衣和窄深色领带。双膝分开，双手松松地合在膝上。浅色袜子露在褐色鞋子上方，鞋伸到溅满颜料的混凝土地面上。他平静地直视镜头，在忙乱房间里形成一个小而静止的中心。沙发右侧的台面放着罐子和其他工作室材料。前景地板上还有松散笔痕、碎屑和涂抹色块。照片如实记录粗糙颜料层和磨旧布料，没有抹平其不规则表面。柔和的室内日光从前方及右侧散开，均匀照亮男子、沙发和墙面，仅在家具下方留下轻微阴影。整体构图以居中的坐姿和两侧对称黄靠垫平衡奔放、杂乱的色彩与手工痕迹。
style_prompt_en: The color photographic treatment records a dense accumulation of hand-worked surfaces within a clear, level frame. Dusty pink and cream provide a warm base, repeatedly interrupted by mustard, turquoise, coral, cobalt, charcoal, and white. Layered marks vary in scale from broad smeared fields to tiny quick lines and scattered dots, allowing earlier traces to remain visible beneath later ones. A relatively quiet central interval gives the eye a resting point while energetic pattern spreads toward the edges. Familiar material textures remain distinct: worn fabric, dry paint, paper edges, and marked concrete each respond differently to light. Soft even illumination preserves color and detail without dramatic cast shadows. The many overlapping planes make the space visually full, yet stable horizontal and vertical lines hold the composition together. The overall effect is vivid and lived-in, with archival photographic clarity meeting exuberant, tactile color.
style_prompt_zh: 这种彩色摄影处理以清楚、平视的取景记录密集累积的手工表面。灰粉与奶油色提供暖底，芥黄、青绿、珊瑚红、钴蓝、炭灰和白色反复打断它。层叠痕迹尺度多变，从宽阔的涂抹色域到细小迅疾线条与散落圆点，较早痕迹仍从后加色层下露出。较安静的中央间隔给眼睛一个停靠处，活跃纹样则向边缘蔓延。普通材料肌理保持分明：磨旧布料、干颜料、纸边和有痕地面以各自方式承接光线。柔和均匀的照明保留颜色与细节，没有戏剧化投影。众多叠压色面让空间视觉上十分充实，稳定的水平与垂直线仍把构图维系起来。整体效果鲜活而有人生活过的感觉，以档案般清晰的摄影遇上奔放、可触知的色彩。
theme_en: A suited man seated on a patterned sofa in a paint-covered pink studio
theme_zh: 穿西装的男子坐在粉色、遍布绘画痕迹的工作室花纹沙发上
name: Bjarne Melgaard
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
